MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 22
   C. 19
   D. 38

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

7. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 100

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 28
   D. 11

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 16
   C. 9
   D. 7

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 120
   C. 23
   D. 30

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 0

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 23
   C. 17
   D. 7

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

22. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

25. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

26. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

27. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

28. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

29. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
